sourceTitle: Illustrations of the birds of Jamaica
description: "Illustrations of the Birds of Jamaica" by Philip Henry Gosse is a scientific publication created in the mid-19th century, specifically in 1849. This book accompanies Gosse's previous work, "The Birds of Jamaica," providing detailed ornithological illustrations of various bird species found in Jamaica.
